name: Bhringraj Powder 100gm–Supports Hair Growth
original_description:
Bhringraj Powder is an ancient herb found throughout India. Bhringraj means “Ruler of the hair”. It is also considered as a genera I tonic for debility. It is considered to maintain healthy digestive health.

Benefits of Bhringraj Powder

  • May encourage hair growth.
  • May support overall health of hair.
  • May help maintain natural hair luster.

Direction for use: Take 3 gms powder, 1 to 2 times a day
rewritten_description: Bhringraj Powder is an ancient herb native to India, revered for its traditional significance. The name Bhringraj translates to "Ruler of the hair", reflecting its historical importance. This herbal powder has been a part of traditional practices for centuries, valued for its potential to support overall well-being.
